headline: Expanse Tilts Warden as Callahans Passage Toll Mounts
war_summary: Since our last edition the Weathered Expanse has tilted toward Warden colours, five stands to two with two in ruin, after more than fifty base events in a day around Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Wightwalk. In Mooring County the lone Colonial gain has been undone; all twelve stands once more fly Warden flags. The Nevish Line remains the bloodiest ground, six stands to two, its combined losses approaching fifteen hundred an hour and still climbing about Blackcoat Way. Callahans Passage, held wholly under Warden flags, has passed twelve thousand casualties in a day, its hourly rate second only to the Line. Linn Mercy stays busiest for flag movements, fighting logged minutes before this edition went to press, Warden losses running double the Colonial rate near Lathair, with ten of eleven stands Colonial-held. Marban Hollow has been silent since the small hours, its four-three split intact, and Stlican Shelf has cooled. It is day 739; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
